decisions.reason: Ending the project does not modify or invalidate the established Hero V and É accent peak-alignment rule, and the source does not specifically change that relationship.
The source ends further design work but does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes.
The reported failure of the Hero V and second V hierarchy does not entail a change to the rule that both V bottom points share the E and L baseline.
The project-ending decision and request for editable working files do not alter the accepted formats for viewable iteration proofs.
